messages:
Maya: Quick thread — we need a tight latency vs cost storyline for next week. Focus: launch post, webinar hooks, and inbound routing.
Tom: I like 2 hero charts: 1) cost per 1M tokens across deployment modes, 2) p50/p95 latency vs throughput slices. Keep them simple and headline-ready.
Sophia: For webinar signups, tag leads as `source:webinar-latency-cost` and pipe to inbound SDR queue. Add a 1-question survey to segment by infra needs (on-prem, VPC, hosted).
Oliver: Data ask: can eng send p50/p95 for hosted/dedicated/private on 8k and 4k sequences? We should include a concrete "typical app" example (chat widget, 200 tokens/res).
BenchBot: perf CSV uploaded: https://internal.redwood/perf/1765432100/results.csv :thumbsup:
Maya: Messaging test: two hooks — "Same API, predictable cost" vs "Save ~35% with smart batching & caching". Use the stat that's truest for the target audience.
Tom: A/B copy plan: short social post (1 stat + CTA) vs long-form blog (methodology + charts). Social gets a single, bold stat. Blog links to detailed appendix.
Sophia: Inbound routing logic proposal: webinar leads with >50 seats -> AE queue; 10–50 -> SDR; <10 -> self-serve nurture. Add tags for "compliance-required" if they check regulated workload box.
Oliver: Also want a one-slide fallback story: show how smart routing falls back to cheaper model variants during spikes to maintain SLA. Small diagram + numbers.
Maya: Action items — @Oliver export p50/p95 by sequence length, @BenchBot confirm CSV columns and sample rows, @Tom draft social + blog outline, @Sophia draft routing rules and survey copy. Sync tomorrow 10:00am PT. :calendar:
